title: iScheduler: Reinforcement Learning-Driven Continual Optimization for Large-Scale Resource Investment Problems
abstract: arXiv:2602.06064v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scheduling precedence-constrained tasks under shared renewable resources is critical to modern computing platforms. It is often modeled as the Resource Investment Problem (RIP) by minimizing the cost of provisioned renewable resources under precedence and timing constraints. Unfortunately, exact mixed-integer programming and constraint programming become impractically slow on large RIP instances, and dynamic updates require schedule revisions under tight latency budgets. To address this, we present iScheduler, a reinforcement-learning-driven iterative scheduling framework for large RIP. Specifically, it formulates RIP solving as a Markov decision process over decomposed subproblems and constructs schedules through sequential process selection. translated_title: iScheduler：强化学习驱动的大规模资源投资问题持续优化
translated_abstract: 在共享可再生资源下调度具有优先级约束的任务对现代计算平台至关重要。这通常被建模为资源投资问题（RIP），通过在优先级和时间约束下最小化配置可再生资源的成本来实现。不幸的是，精确的混合整数规划和约束规划在大型RIP实例上变得不切实际地缓慢，且动态更新需要在紧张的延迟预算内进行调度修订。为解决这一问题，我们提出了iScheduler，一个用于大型RIP的强化学习驱动的迭代调度框架。具体来说，它将RIP求解表述为对分解子问题的马尔可夫决策过程，并通过顺序过程选择来构建调度。通过这样做，该框架加速了优化，并通过重用未改变的过程调度和仅重新调度受影响的过程来支持重新配置。为评估该框架...
tldr: 本文提出iScheduler框架，利用强化学习将大型资源投资问题分解为子问题并迭代调度，显著加速优化并支持动态重配置，仅重调度受影响过程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes iScheduler, a reinforcement-learning-driven iterative scheduling framework that decomposes large resource investment problems into subproblems, accelerating optimization and enabling dynamic reconfiguration by rescheduling only affected processes.
